Name: Old timey Reshade presets
Author: rennxf99
Description:
[font=Trebuchet MS][b][size=5]2 flavours of reshade presets. vintage gives a vintage camera aesthetic, expect warm tones and hazy lights. dark gives a more grungy and overall darker feel. `check images for comparisons[/size][/b]

[b][size=3]-If you are changing from a different preset make sure to reinstall and update reshade to have all the files needed for the intended look. (go through install again)-[/size][/b]


[size=5]Basic Install[/size]

[/font][spoiler]
[size=3]
 1. Download preset (you can pick both) from here and extract it to your stardew folder (eg. C:\...\steamapps\common\Stardew Valley)
 2. Download and run [url=https://reshade.me/downloads/ReShade_Setup_6.0.1.exe]ReShade[/url]﻿ 
 3. Look for StardewModdingAPI or Stardew Valley (if playing vanilla)
 4. Select OpenGL
 5. Pick whatever option that downloads new files
 6. Hit browse go into your stardew folder and look for the preset you downloaded earlier (either "rens dark.ini" or "rens vintage.ini") then click finish
 7. In-game press "home" on your keyboard and select the preset in the dropdown box

 Enjoy 😊[/size]

[/spoiler][font=Trebuchet MS]

[b][size=5]Notes[/size]

[/b][/font][list]
[*][font=Trebuchet MS][size=3][b]⭐This preset is performance heavy[/b][b]⭐[/b](especially if you are playing on a laptop or older pc), if its too laggy try disabling RadiantGI in the effects (see stickied post)[/size][/font]
[*][font=Trebuchet MS][size=3]If the ui is too bright try adjusting the settings under magic bloom or disabling it altogether[/size][/font]
[/list][font=Trebuchet MS]
